about: iNaturalist, a citizen-science biodiversity platform. This CLI searches and reads observations, taxa, places, projects and users through iNaturalist's documented public read-only API (api.inaturalist.org/v1), which the iNaturalist web app itself calls.

commands.summary: Search wildlife observations by text, taxon, place, user, quality grade and date range, with sorting and pagination

params.name: q
params.description: Free-text search, matched against taxon names, descriptions and place names

params.name: taxon_id
params.description: Restrict to this taxon and its descendants. Takes a numeric taxon id, or several ids separated by commas.

params.name: place_id
params.description: Restrict to a place. Takes a numeric place id (find ids with search-places).

params.name: user_id
params.description: Restrict to one observer, given as a user login or numeric id

params.name: project_id
params.description: Restrict to a project, given as a project id or slug

params.name: iconic_taxa
params.description: Broad group. Comma-separated values from: Plantae, Aves, Insecta, Mammalia, Reptilia, Amphibia, Actinopterygii, Mollusca, Arachnida, Fungi, Protozoa, Chromista, Animalia

params.name: d1
params.description: Observed on or after this date (ISO, e.g. 2024-01-31)

params.name: d2
params.description: Observed on or before this date (ISO, e.g. 2024-12-31)

params.name: photos
params.description: Only return observations that have photos

commands.summary: Get full details of one observation by its numeric id: taxon, photos, location, identifications and observer

params.name: id
params.description: Numeric observation id (the id field from search-observations)

commands.summary: Count observed species (leaf taxa) matching observation filters, e.g. the most-observed species in a place

params.name: taxon_id
params.description: Restrict to descendants of this taxon id

params.name: user_id
params.description: Restrict to one observer, given as a login or id

params.name: project_id
params.description: Restrict to a project, given as an id or slug

params.name: d1
params.description: Observed on or after this date (ISO date)

params.name: d2
params.description: Observed on or before this date (ISO date)

commands.summary: List the users with the most observations that match the given filters (taxon, place, project)

params.name: taxon_id
params.description: Restrict to descendants of this taxon id

commands.summary: Search taxa (species, genera, families and so on) by scientific or common name, optionally filtered by rank

params.name: q
params.description: Scientific or common name to search for

commands.summary: Get details of a taxon by numeric id: name, rank, ancestry, common name, conservation status and Wikipedia summary

params.name: id
params.description: Numeric taxon id, e.g. 47851 (Quercus, the oaks). Several ids can be given separated by commas.

commands.summary: Find places (countries, states, parks and so on) by name to get the place_id that the observation filters use
Search iNaturalist projects (bioblitzes, collections, umbrella projects) by name

params.name: place_id
params.description: Only projects associated with this place id

commands.summary: Get a user's public profile (login, name, observation and species counts) by login or numeric id

params.name: id
params.description: User login or numeric user id

commands.summary: List identifications (species IDs that users added to observations), filterable by taxon, identifier and whether they are current

params.name: observation_id
params.description: Only identifications on this observation id

params.name: current
params.description: Only identifications that are each user's current ID
